features.text: Innovative gel pad system provides dual-action hot/cold therapy capabilities, allowing targeted temperature treatment while maintaining necessary support for optimal healing
Protective anatomical shells offer medical-grade stability on both sides of the ankle, featuring cushioned support for extended wear comfort
Available in both 50% and 80% surface gel coverage options, allowing you to choose the ideal level of therapeutic contact for your specific condition
Advanced lace-lock system ensures secure positioning and customizable compression, perfect for managing various levels of ankle instability
